reason: The cited evidence (E1–E3) describes general RHEA properties and trade-offs but provides no data on Al additions to HfMoTaTiZr, Al solubility in this specific BCC matrix, or its effects on lattice distortion, dislocation mechanisms, or density-strength trade-offs. The key premises are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Al can dissolve into the single-phase BCC solid solution of HfMoTaTiZr.
Al substitution for Hf will maintain similar lattice distortion and solid-solution strengthening.
The modified alloy will retain similar dislocation mechanisms (screw/edge transition) for strength and ductility.
Density will be reduced by 8–15% with only ~10% loss in strength/ductility.
